description.text: Training objectives: This major is oriented to the training of application-oriented talents, cultivates moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor all-round development, has basic knowledge of mechanical design and manufacturing and automation and research and application capabilities, faces the needs of intelligent manufacturing and sustainable development, adapts to future scientific and technological progress, has good scientific, engineering and humanistic literacy, has a strong sense of innovation and entrepreneurship, engineering practice ability and teamwork spirit, can engage in design and manufacturing, scientific and technological development, High-quality composite engineering and technical talents engaged in scientific research, teaching, management and other work in applied research and operation management or in related industries. Professional courses: mechanics, mechanical design, electrical and electronic technology, engineering materials and mechanical manufacturing basics, mechanical CAD/CAM, interchangeability and technical measurement, factory data acquisition and monitoring control system, manufacturing execution system technology application, industrial robot technology and application, machine vision inspection technology, automatic control principle, hydraulic and pneumatic transmission, programming controller and frequency converter. Practical teaching links: mechanical manufacturing process cognitive practice, basic manufacturing technology training, advanced manufacturing technology training, electromechanical comprehensive technology training, manufacturing execution system technology application training, factory data acquisition and monitoring control system training, robot ontology design and motion analysis, manufacturing execution system application development, industrial robot comprehensive technology training, etc.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering and Automation at zaozhuang university is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 833 USD/per year ￥ 6000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form 2. Highest degree diploma (notarized copy) 3. Highest degree transcript (notarized copy) 4. Certificate of Employment or Study 5. Photographs with White Background (Size 35mm X 53mm) 6. Health Certificate 7. Passport 8. Non-criminal Record Certificate

requirements.text: Healthy, loving Chinese culture, with high school education or above, aged from18-26.
